releaseNotes: v2.0.0: DVR fully fixed and hardened. KSP migration for faster builds. USB/OTG storage persists across app restarts. Full DVR playback crash resolution.
changelog: CRITICAL FIX: DVR playback crash — fd:// is not a valid LibVLC URI on Android. Now uses file:///proc/self/fd/N (correct kernel symlink format)
CRITICAL FIX: DVR playback crash — absolute file paths now properly prefixed with file:// so LibVLC can parse the URI scheme
CRITICAL FIX: DVR auto-recovery loop also crashed because it bypassed URI resolution — now calls resolveDvrUri() before rebuilding media
CRITICAL FIX: USB/OTG storage path now persisted to DataStore — survives app kill/restart. No more re-selecting USB drive every launch
HIGH FIX: Room DB now has explicit Migration(5,6) — dvr_recordings table is preserved on app update instead of being wiped by fallbackToDestructiveMigration
NEW: RecordingService polls file size every 30 seconds and updates Active tab UI with live recording size
NEW: DVR Play button is greyed/disabled when filePath is empty (recording active or path not yet saved) — prevents silent no-op taps
PERF: Migrated Hilt + Room annotation processing from KAPT to KSP — ~40% faster incremental builds, eliminates language version 2.0 fallback warnings
FIX: RecordingService coroutine scope now properly cancelled on onDestroy() — no more coroutine leaks when service is killed

_instructions.step1: Upload app-firestick-release.apk to Dropbox, get shareable link, change ?dl=0 to ?dl=1
_instructions.step2: Upload app-premium-release.apk to Dropbox, get shareable link, change ?dl=0 to ?dl=1
_instructions.step3: Replace YOUR_FIRESTICK_DROPBOX_LINK_HERE with your Firestick APK Dropbox link
_instructions.step4: Replace YOUR_PREMIUM_DROPBOX_LINK_HERE with your Premium APK Dropbox link
_instructions.step5: Also update the top-level 'apkUrl' field to point to the Firestick APK
_instructions.step6: Paste the final JSON into your GitHub Gist (raw URL must match GIST_UPDATE_URL in build.gradle.kts)
